text: Critical carrier failure: immediately re-route to backup carrier and notify customer.
High-severity weather or port delay on perishable goods: expedite via fastest available lane.
Shipment lost or damaged beyond repair: initiate claims process with carrier.
Wrong route detected with no customer impact: cancel current leg and re-route.
Low-severity delay on non-perishable standard tier: apply standard recovery procedure.
Customer cancels order while shipment is still recoverable: cancel shipment.
